# SimEngine

> A domain-agnostic Monte Carlo simulation and decision-intelligence engine.
> Zero third-party Python dependencies (stdlib only, Python 3.8+), one-file web
> UI on port 8420, an HTTP API designed for AI agents, and an MCP server with 12
> tools including a proceed/escalate decision gate and docs-wiki search. Open-core: the engine is
> Apache-2.0; the hosted MCP service is commercial.

Key facts for agents:
- Define a decision problem as a single JSON config (parameters / controls /
  exogenous variables, step logic, metrics, safety constraints); the engine
  runs thousands of futures and returns distributions, safety verdicts, and an
  optional evolutionary optimum. `simulate` is synchronous — results come back
  in the same response.
- The config contract is published JSON Schema: `GET /api/schema`
  (v3/schema/domain.schema.json). Validate with `POST /api/validate` before
  running. Probe liveness with `GET /api/health`.
- Forecast accuracy is accounted for, not asserted: a sqlite calibration
  ledger scores resolved forecasts with Brier / log-loss / CRPS, and the
  forecasting pipeline is backtested on ~2,800 walk-forward monthly forecasts
  over decades of public FRED data (docs/backtests/).
- Outputs are decision support and scenario analysis, never financial advice
  or trade signals.

## Install

- MCP server: `uvx simengine-mcp` — listed on the
  [official MCP registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/?search=simengine).
- Hosted, no-install endpoint: [join the waitlist](https://cogswellspacely8-star.github.io/simengine-site/#waitlist).

## Docs

- [Docs wiki home](docs/README.md): index of every doc by section; also served
  over MCP via `list_docs` / `search_docs` / `read_doc` and `simengine://docs/...`
  resources
- [README](README.md): quick start, architecture, native acceleration
- [Agent integration guide](v3/AGENT_INTEGRATION.md): how an AI agent builds,
  validates, runs, and interprets a simulation (curl for every endpoint)
- [Schema reference](docs/schema-reference.md): plain-language config contract
- [Decision gate](docs/decision-gate.md): the `decide_under_uncertainty` MCP
  tool — proceed/escalate on outcome risk
- [Calibration backtest](docs/backtests/2026-07-06-fred-monthly-calibration.md):
  historical validation results and the claims they do (and do not) support

## API

- [OpenAPI spec](v3/openapi.yaml): machine-readable HTTP contract
- Endpoints: POST /api/simulate, /api/validate, /api/evolve, /api/update,
  /api/ask, /api/forecast, /api/resolve; GET /api/domains, /api/schema,
  /api/forecasts, /api/health

## Examples

- [Domain template](v3/domains/_template.json): annotated starting config
- [Example domains](v3/domains/): SaaS runway, sales pipeline, real estate,
  portfolio, supply chain, and more

## Optional

- [Commercial license](LICENSE-COMMERCIAL.md): hosted MCP terms
- [Rust acceleration](crates/): opt-in native kernels; the engine always
  falls back to pure Python
